The Character tab is your central hub for personalizing every call. You can choose a character to represent you (Player Character) and assign different characters to each of your contacts (Contact Characters).
Tap “Add trainer” or “Add monster” in the respective settings to create your own. You can pick images from your gallery for:
Front Sprite: Seen by you when this contact calls.
Back Sprite: Seen as your own character during battles.
For Monsters, you can expand the “Advanced” section to set their Level and Max HP. You can also toggle the “Radiant” status manually for characters you create yourself.
MonsterDialer uses two types of shareable files:
.monstercharacter: A single character with its stats and artwork.
.monsterpack: A collection of multiple characters, often themed.
Long-press any of your custom characters to export them as .monstercharacter files. To import either type, simply open a file someone sent you or use the “Import character” button.

To share a collection of your custom monsters, you can create a Pack. Go to “Character Packs” and tap “Create pack” (this button appears once you’ve created at least one character). Select the monsters you want to include, and you can then export the final .monsterpack file to share with others.

Radiant monsters are rare, sparkling variants. Unlike normal characters, variants in packs are locked until you encounter them “in the wild” during a call. Once found, they unlock automatically for your collection, and you can share a special discovery card to show off your find!
Long-press any character in the “Your monsters” or “Your trainers” sections to Edit, Share, or Delete it. Built-in characters and those from imported packs cannot be modified.
There are two ways to use characters:
Player Character: This is your avatar. Set it in “Player Character” settings to represent you in every call.
Contact Characters: Assign specific monsters or trainers to individual contacts in “Contact Characters.” They will appear as your opponent when they call you.
